mapper.select: SELECT DATE(a.schedule_date) AS scheduleDate, a.schedule_date AS date, COUNT(a.id) AS assignmentCount, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT(a.user_name, '(', s.shift_name, ')') ORDER BY s.sort_order, a.user_name SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS assignmentInfo, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.color ORDER BY s.sort_order) AS colors FROM jsh_schedule_assignment a LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_shift s ON a.shift_id = s.id AND ifnull(s.delete_flag,'0') != '1' WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND YEAR(a.schedule_date) = #{year,jdbcType=INTEGER} AND MONTH(a.schedule_date) = #{month,jdbcType=INTEGER} GROUP BY DATE(a.schedule_date) ORDER BY a.schedule_date ASC

SELECT a.id, a.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, a.user_id AS userId, a.user_name AS userName, a.shift_id AS shiftId, s.shift_name AS shiftName, s.shift_type AS shiftType, s.color AS shiftColor, CONCAT(s.start_time, '-', s.end_time) AS shiftTime, a.status, CASE a.status WHEN 'SCHEDULED' THEN '已排班' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN '已确认' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' ELSE a.status END AS statusName, a.notes, a.work_hours AS workHours, a.check_in_time AS checkInTime, a.check_out_time AS checkOutTime FROM jsh_schedule_assignment a LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_shift s ON a.shift_id = s.id AND ifnull(s.delete_flag,'0') != '1' WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND DATE(a.schedule_date) = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, a.user_name ASC

SELECT a.id, a.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, a.shift_id AS shiftId, s.shift_name AS shiftName, s.shift_type AS shiftType, s.color AS shiftColor, CONCAT(s.start_time, '-', s.end_time) AS shiftTime, a.status, CASE a.status WHEN 'SCHEDULED' THEN '已排班' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN '已确认' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' ELSE a.status END AS statusName, a.notes, a.work_hours AS workHours, a.check_in_time AS checkInTime, a.check_out_time AS checkOutTime FROM jsh_schedule_assignment a LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_shift s ON a.shift_id = s.id AND ifnull(s.delete_flag,'0') != '1' WHERE a.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY a.schedule_date ASC, s.sort_order ASC

SELECT COUNT(a.id) AS totalAssignments, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS uniqueUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT a.shift_id) AS uniqueShifts, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(a.schedule_date)) AS uniqueDates, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'SCHEDULED' THEN 1 END) AS scheduledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) AS confirmedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS cancelledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedCount, ROUND(AVG(a.work_hours), 2) AS avgWorkHours, SUM(a.work_hours) AS totalWorkHours FROM jsh_schedule_assignment a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT a.user_id AS userId, a.user_name AS userName, COUNT(a.id) AS totalAssignments, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedAssignments, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.id), 2) AS completionRate, SUM(a.work_hours) AS totalWorkHours, ROUND(AVG(a.work_hours), 2) AS avgWorkHours, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(a.schedule_date)) AS workDays FROM jsh_schedule_assignment a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY a.user_id, a.user_name ORDER BY totalWorkHours DESC, completionRate DESC

SELECT s.id AS shiftId, s.shift_name AS shiftName, s.shift_type AS shiftType, s.color AS shiftColor, COUNT(a.id) AS usageCount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS uniqueUsers, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.id), 2) AS completionRate, SUM(a.work_hours) AS totalWorkHours, ROUND(AVG(a.work_hours), 2) AS avgWorkHours FROM jsh_schedule_shift s LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_assignment a ON s.id = a.shift_id AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(s.delete_flag,'0') != '1' GROUP BY s.id, s.shift_name, s.shift_type, s.color ORDER BY usageCount DESC, s.sort_order ASC

SELECT a1.id AS assignment1Id, a1.user_name AS userName, a1.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s1.shift_name AS shift1Name, s1.start_time AS shift1StartTime, s1.end_time AS shift1EndTime, a2.id AS assignment2Id, s2.shift_name AS shift2Name, s2.start_time AS shift2StartTime, s2.end_time AS shift2EndTime, 'TIME_OVERLAP' AS conflictType, '班次时间重叠' AS conflictDescription FROM jsh_schedule_assignment a1 JOIN jsh_schedule_assignment a2 ON a1.user_id = a2.user_id AND a1.schedule_date = a2.schedule_date AND a1.id != a2.id LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_shift s1 ON a1.shift_id = s1.id LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_shift s2 ON a2.shift_id = s2.id WHERE a1.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a1.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND ifnull(a2.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND a1.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND ( (s1.start_time <= s2.start_time AND s1.end_time > s2.start_time) OR (s1.start_time < s2.end_time AND s1.end_time >= s2.end_time) OR (s1.start_time >= s2.start_time AND s1.end_time <= s2.end_time) ) ORDER BY a1.schedule_date ASC, a1.user_name ASC
